answer: Each identity builds its standing like timber for a jetty — but the jetty only holds if the delta of its contributions stays positive: each epoch, an identity must do more verified useful work than the last, or its standing sinks. A fake that repeats the same trick has a zero delta, and one that coasts has a negative delta, so a farm of a thousand fakes cannot bulk-buy standing: each fake must grow its own verified contributions, one epoch at a time, and the growth must be real, checked by established peers.
